Extracts response metadata from HTTP headers (etag, server, content-language)

```elixir title="Elixir"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.response_meta.etag)
IO.inspect(result.response_meta.last_modified)
IO.inspect(result.response_meta.server)
IO.inspect(result.response_meta.content_language)
```
